_comment: AutoForm view scheme for HYDROPRO / HYDRO++. Short labels; detail in tooltips (description). Compute runs in gui/tool.py via core.run_hydro.

sections.title: Executable & input
sections.description: HYDRO executable and the structures to process.

sections.label: Executable
sections.description: Path to the HYDROPRO or HYDRO++ executable. The flavour is auto-detected from the filename.

sections.label: Structures
sections.description: Comma-separated structural files (PDB or bead coordinate files). Set with the 'Select files…' button.

sections.title: Primary model
sections.description: Bead/shell model definition (HYDROPRO manual §3.a).

sections.label: INDMODE
sections.description: 1 = atomic/shell; 2 = residue/shell; 4 = residue/bead.

sections.label: AER
sections.description: Hydrodynamic radius of primary elements. Typical: 2.9 (mode 1), 4.8 (2), 6.1 (4).

sections.label: NSIG
sections.description: Number of minibead radii (>2, typically 5–8). Use -1 for automatic SIGMIN/SIGMAX.

sections.label: SIGMIN
sections.description: Minimum minibead radius (shell modes 1/2 when NSIG ≠ -1).

sections.label: SIGMAX
sections.description: Maximum minibead radius (shell modes 1/2 when NSIG ≠ -1).

sections.title: Solvent & macromolecule
sections.description: Solution properties (HYDROPRO manual §3.b).

sections.label: T
sections.description: Temperature in centigrade.

sections.label: ETA
sections.description: Solvent viscosity in poises (water at 20 °C ≈ 0.01 P).

sections.label: RM
sections.description: Molecular weight in daltons.

sections.label: VBAR
sections.description: Partial specific volume (proteins ≈ 0.73–0.75 cm³/g).

sections.label: RHO
sections.description: Solution (≈ solvent) density in g/cm³.

sections.title: Optional calculations
sections.description: Scattering, distance distribution and covolume (HYDROPRO manual §3.c).

sections.label: NQ
sections.description: Scattering q values: 0 omit, -1 automatic, >0 specify QMAX.

sections.label: QMAX
sections.description: Upper limit of scattering variable q (only when NQ > 0).

sections.label: NS
sections.description: Intervals for the distance distribution p(r): 0 omit, -1 automatic, >0 specify RMAX.

sections.label: RMAX
sections.description: Maximum distance for p(r) (only when NS > 0).

sections.label: NTRIALS
sections.description: Monte-Carlo trials for the covolume calculation (0 to omit; very time-consuming).

sections.label: Full diffusion tensor
sections.description: IDIF=1: output the full 6×6 diffusion tensor and diffusion centre.

sections.title: Results
sections.description: Populated after a run completes.

sections.label: Status
sections.description: Outcome of the last run.
